title: Collaborative Mechanism of Privacy Computing and Blockchain in Multi-Center Medical Data Sharing

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Collaborative Mechanism of Privacy Computing and Blockchain in Multi-Center Medical Data Sharing》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Goal: This protocol aims to resolve the tension between collaborative utility and data sovereignty by integrating federated learning (FL) with blockchain technology, providing a secure, auditable, and scalable framework for medical data sharing.

evidence.text: Goal: This protocol aims to resolve the tension between collaborative utility and data sovereignty by integrating federated learning (FL) with blockchain technology, providing a secure, auditable, and scalable framework for medical data sharing.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Collaborative Mechanism of Privacy Computing and Blockchain in Multi-Center Medical Data Sharing》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】The framework employs a tripartite architecture: cryptographic FL with adaptive regularization and Paillier homomorphic encryption for privacy-preserving local training; a multi-channel, tiered-sharding blockchain for decoupled access control, data provenance, and FL operation logging; and a dynamic privacy-computation coordination mechanism that adapts differential privacy and cryptographic protocols based on data sensitivity and hardware capability.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Under experimental conditions, the framework achieved 92.5% model accuracy after 20 training rounds and supported up to 30 nodes.

Under experimental conditions, the framework achieved 92.5% model accuracy after 20 training rounds and supported up to 30 nodes.
